description: System Query Search Templates - Templates for searching and analyzing system queries

templates.name: Basic System Query Search
templates.description: Search templates by specific system queries they use
templates.query: query BasicSystemQuerySearch($limit: Int = 20) { searchTemplates(limit: $limit, orderBy: "usage_count", orderDirection: "DESC") { templates { id identifier name queryName operationType usageCount complexityScore isActive } totalCount } }

templates.name: System Query Usage Analytics
templates.description: Analyze system query usage patterns and identify most commonly used GraphQL operations
templates.query: query SystemQueryAnalytics($minComplexity: Int = 1, $minUsage: Int = 0, $limit: Int = 50) { searchTemplates(filter: { complexityMin: $minComplexity, usageCountMin: $minUsage, isActive: true }, limit: $limit, orderBy: "usage_count", orderDirection: "DESC") { templates { id name queryName operationType usageCount complexityScore avgExecutionTimeMs lastUsedAt tags } totalCount } }

templates.name: High Complexity Template Analysis
templates.description: Find templates with high complexity scores and multiple system queries
templates.query: query HighComplexityTemplates($minComplexity: Int = 5, $limit: Int = 20) { searchTemplates(filter: { complexityMin: $minComplexity, isActive: true }, limit: $limit, orderBy: "complexity_score", orderDirection: "DESC") { templates { id name queryName operationType complexityScore usageCount avgExecutionTimeMs description tags } totalCount } }

templates.name: Table Operation Templates
templates.description: Find all templates that perform table-related operations
templates.query: query TableOperationTemplates($limit: Int = 30) { searchTemplates(limit: $limit) { templates { id name queryName operationType usageCount complexityScore } totalCount } }

templates.name: Mutation Templates Analysis
templates.description: Analyze all mutation templates and their system query patterns
templates.query: query MutationTemplatesAnalysis($limit: Int = 25) { searchTemplates(limit: $limit, orderBy: "updated_at", orderDirection: "DESC") { templates { id name queryName operationType usageCount lastUsedAt avgExecutionTimeMs isActive } totalCount } }

templates.name: Performance Bottleneck Detection
templates.description: Identify templates with high execution times and analyze their system query patterns
templates.query: query PerformanceBottleneckDetection($minExecutionTime: Int = 100, $limit: Int = 15) { searchTemplates(filter: { usageCountMin: 1, isActive: true }, limit: $limit, orderBy: "usage_count", orderDirection: "DESC") { templates { id name queryName operationType avgExecutionTimeMs usageCount complexityScore lastUsedAt } totalCount } }

templates.name: Recent Template Activity Analysis
templates.description: Track recently used templates and their system query patterns
templates.query: query RecentTemplateActivity($limit: Int = 20) { searchTemplates(filter: { usageCountMin: 1, isActive: true }, limit: $limit, orderBy: "updated_at", orderDirection: "DESC") { templates { id name queryName operationType usageCount lastUsedAt complexityScore tags } totalCount } }

templates.name: Comprehensive System Query Overview
templates.description: Complete overview of all system queries, usage patterns, and performance metrics
templates.query: query ComprehensiveSystemOverview($limit: Int = 100) { allTemplates: searchTemplates(limit: $limit) { templates { id name queryName operationType usageCount complexityScore avgExecutionTimeMs isActive tags createdAt } totalCount } }

metadata.purpose: System query search and analysis functionality
